name: Longsuffering
overview: Longsuffering, as revealed in Scripture, is a vital fruit of the Spirit characterized by patient endurance through trials and afflictions while maintaining purity, knowledge, kindness, and love (2 Corinthians 6:4-6; Galatians 5:22). Believers are called to embody this quality with humility and meekness, bearing with one another in love as they walk worthy of their calling (Ephesians 4:1-2). This steadfast patience is both a mark of godly character and a reflection of Christ’s enduring love.
